---
title: "Student List"
---


```{r}
#| label: tbl-student-list-table
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(knitr)

source(file.path(
    dirname(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE)),
    "_data_helpers.R"
))

# Read student register
register_df <- read_workbook_sheet(cf_sheet("register"))

if (is.null(register_df)) {

    notify_workbook_missing()

} else {

    register_df <- as.data.frame(register_df)

    student_df <- get_register_columns(
        register_df,
        c(
            "serial_no",
            "section",
            "admission_no",
            "student_name"
        )
    )

    names(student_df) <- c(
        "S. No.",
        "Branch / Section",
        "Admission No",
        "Student Name"
    )

    # Remove records without student names
    student_df <- student_df[
        !is.na(student_df[["Student Name"]]) &
        nzchar(trimws(as.character(student_df[["Student Name"]]))),
        ,
        drop = FALSE
    ]

    rownames(student_df) <- NULL

    # Replace missing values with "-"
    student_df[] <- lapply(student_df, function(x) {
        x <- as.character(x)
        x[is.na(x) | !nzchar(trimws(x))] <- "-"
        x
    })

    table_caption <- paste0(
        "Student List for ",
        cf_value("course-code"),
        " ",
        cf_value("section-name")
    )

    # Select rendering package based on output format
    if (knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) {

        library(flextable)

        student_tbl <- flextable(student_df) |>
            set_caption(caption = table_caption) |>
            theme_booktabs() |>
            bold(part = "header") |>
            bg(
                i = seq(2, nrow(student_df), by = 2),
                bg = "#F3F5F7",
                part = "body"
            ) |>
            align(
                j = 1:3,
                align = "center",
                part = "all"
            ) |>
            align(
                j = 4,
                align = "left",
                part = "all"
            ) |>
            valign(
                valign = "center",
                part = "all"
            ) |>
            fontsize(
                size = 9,
                part = "all"
            ) |>
            width(j = 1, width = 0.55) |>
            width(j = 2, width = 1.25) |>
            width(j = 3, width = 1.45) |>
            width(j = 4, width = 2.80) |>
            padding(
                padding = 4,
                part = "all"
            ) |>
            set_table_properties(
                layout = "fixed",
                opts_word = list(
                    repeat_headers = TRUE,
                    split = FALSE
                )
            )

    } else {

        library(kableExtra)

        if (knitr::is_latex_output()) {

            student_tbl <- kbl(
                student_df,
                format = "latex",
                longtable = TRUE,
                booktabs = TRUE,
                caption = table_caption,
                row.names = FALSE,
                align = c("c", "c", "c", "l")
            ) |>
                kable_styling(
                    latex_options = c(
                        "repeat_header",
                        "striped"
                    ),
                    stripe_color = "gray!12",
                    font_size = 9,
                    full_width = FALSE
                ) |>
                column_spec(1, width = "0.55in") |>
                column_spec(2, width = "1.25in") |>
                column_spec(3, width = "1.45in") |>
                column_spec(4, width = "2.80in")

        } else {

            student_tbl <- kbl(
                student_df,
                format = "html",
                caption = table_caption,
                row.names = FALSE,
                align = c("c", "c", "c", "l")
            ) |>
                kable_styling(
                    bootstrap_options = c(
                        "striped",
                        "bordered",
                        "hover",
                        "condensed"
                    ),
                    full_width = FALSE,
                    position = "center"
                ) |>
                row_spec(
                    0,
                    bold = TRUE,
                    background = "#E8EDF2"
                )
        }
    }

    # Explicitly invoke the registered knitr renderer.
    # This works even inside an if/else block.
    knitr::knit_print(student_tbl)
}
```
